build_hunyuan3d_shape_pipeline: build a four-stage pipeline for Hunyuan3D shape generation from a single input image
create_before_denoising_stage: create a Hunyuan3DShapeBeforeDenoisingStage with image processor, conditioner, VAE, model, scheduler, and config
run_denoising_stage: run a Hunyuan3DShapeDenoisingStage with transformer and scheduler to denoise latents with CFG guidance
export_mesh_from_latents: export a 3D mesh from VAE-decoded latents using marching cubes or octree surface extraction
save_mesh_to_file: save a generated mesh to OBJ or GLB file path with automatic directory creation
